summary: Gamehaus Holdings filed a Form 6-K covering a routine board committee reorganization. Directors Yimin Cai and Feng Xie resigned from the compensation and nominating committees, respectively, effective September 28, 2026; neither exit stemmed from any disagreement with the company. The board appointed Yuhao Wang to chair compensation and Yan Gong to chair nominating; the seven-member board composition is unchanged. No special-situation transaction or forced management departure occurred, so the item is classified as ordinary governance disclosure with no deal terms to monitor.
